comments.body:
**merge-train (2026-11-17): one commit pushed to this branch — a test only, no change to your code.**

The fix is right, but `PortalConversation.vue` (the header #4518 names, 8 of the 9 changed lines) had no executing test: with that file reverted to `dev`, the new sidebar spec and every other portal spec stayed green.

Pushed `6f500d8d3`: `src/frontend/tests/unit/portalConversationAvatarDisplayLabel.mount.spec.js`. It mounts the real `PortalConversation` with one user and one assistant message and asserts that the header tile and every transcript tile take the display label. It passes at head and fails with `PortalConversation.vue` reverted (`expected 'ap-abc-p105' to be 'Zeta Desk'`).

Not changed, for a follow-up: `PortalAgentDetails.vue:22` and the other slug-keyed avatars (search rows, chat rows, agent picker, rooms, inbox) still derive the tile from the slug, so a labelled agent without an image can show two different tiles on one screen.
